༄༅/ /snying tig gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snying tig gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/ /

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang nyid yi dam lhar bsgoms pa'i spyi bor/ rin po che'i khri dang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang o rgyan pad+ma dbyer med kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang chen po nam mkha'i mdog can rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal dmar mo rus pa'i rgyan dang bcas pa/ phyag g.yas yab la 'khyud cing thod pa bdud rtsis bkang pa g.yon pas yab la stob pa/ yab yum gnyis kyi g.yas su pad+ma las 'brel rtsal dang*/ rang byung rdo rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang 'dra ba g.yas ral gri dang g.yon ut+pa la'i steng du snying tig gi po ti bsnams pa/ g.yon na rgyal sras legs pa dang shākya gzhon nu gnyis spyan ras gzigs dang 'dra ba sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og ma mu tig gi phreng ba 'dren cing g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ mdun du rol pa'i rdo rje dang dar ma rdo rje gnyis phyag rdor dang 'dra ba sku mdog mthing kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu nam mkha' rdo rje dang tshul khrims 'bum gnyis thugs rje chen po dong sprug dang 'dra ba g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ g.yon pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba thugs kar 'dren pa/ gu ru'i spyi gtsug tu nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng du rig 'dzin shrī sing ha sku mdog mi sha kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis rnam snang gi phyag rgya can/ dar ngur smrig gi na bza' gsol ba paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha byad can rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi gtsug tu rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sdigs mdzub nam mkha' gdengs pa/ g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ dbu skra thor gtsug dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/

de'i spyi gtsug tu rdo rje 'chang chen po nam mkha'i mdog can rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ de'i spyi bor rigs lnga yab yum phyag mtshan rigs dang mthun pa/ de'i spyi gtsug tu chos sku kun bzang yab yum sku mdog mthing kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khril sbyor rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de la chos 'brel yod tshad kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob cing 'dren pa'i tshul du bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ bsam/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam lha tshogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong rten gsum pho brang dang bcas pa byon par bsam/ badz+ra sa mā dza dang*/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ brjod pas spyan drang zhing bstim par bya'o/ /de la yan lag bdun pa dang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa 'bul/ de nas mos gus dang ldan pas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥ dngos med mtha' bral ka dag chos kyi sku/ /rang rig gsal dngas lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs/ /kun khyab shar grol sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /dus gsum rang rig bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /dmigs med chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang du/ /chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngo bo ka nas dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun grub rang gsal 'od kyi pho brang du/ /longs sku rigs lnga yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig pa sku ru 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs rje phyogs ris med pa'i pho brang du/ /sprul sku rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang sems 'dzin pa stongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i pho brang du/ /rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/

/chos nyid don dang mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya gar so sa gling gi dur khrod du/ /rig 'dzin shrī sing ha la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde chen 'du 'bral med par byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du/ /o rgyan pad+ma yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gter gnas khra mo brag gi pho brang du/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /phung po lhag med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshogs gnyis rnam par dag pa'i pho brang du/ /las 'brel rtsal dang rang byung rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i pho brang du/ /legs ldan pa dang shākya gzhon nu la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro don phyogs med 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ / gar bzhugs gnas mchog chos kyi pho brang du/ /rgyal ba g.yung ston rol pa'i rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskyed rdzogs brtan pa thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid chos skur shar ba'i pho brang du/ /dar ma mdzad nam mkha' rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs med gdul byar smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsal stong 'dzin pa bral ba'i pho brang du/ /tshul khrims 'bum dang dharma lak+ṣa la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snying dbus a ba dhū ti'i pho brang du/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku lnga lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang lus rnam par dag pa'i pho brang du/ /zhi khro ḍāk+ki'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams len tshad du skyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i pho brang du/ /bka' srung gter bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rkyen ngan bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi/ /bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/

/dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems skye med cig char rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul pa rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid chos skur 'char bar byin gyis rlob/ /mtshan 'bum ci mang 'don/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā gu ru kun bzang yab yum na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ rigs lnga yab yum na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ dga' rab rdo rje na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ shrī sing ha na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pad+ma 'byung gnas na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ ye shes mtsho rgyal na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ rang byung rdo rje na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ rgyal sras legs pa na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ shākya gzhon nu na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ rol pa'i rdo rje na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ dar ma rdo rje na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ ga ga badz+ra na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ tshul khrims 'bum na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ dharma lak+ṣa na mo hūṃ/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pu ṇe lak+ṣa na mo hūṃ/ /zhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i dus su bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi byung nas rang gi spyi bo nas babs/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /rkang mthil dang sen mo'i sbug nas mar thon nas lus phyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam mo/ /de nas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams o rgyan pad+ma yab yum la bstim/ bla ma yab yum gyi gnas gsum nas oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum 'od zer dang bcas pa byung nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam/ de nas bla ma yab yum yang byon nas snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma bstim mo/ /skabs 'dir gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ sems 'dzin byed lugs dang*/ rlung gi thun dang*/
hūṃ sgrub sbyor ba rnams bla ma'i zhal las shes so// //dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)snying tig gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ - PAGE 28 -- PAGE 31 -- PAGE 27 -
